meta.name: write-discoverable-code
meta.description:
Rules for writing code that coding agents (and humans) can find and understand through
plain-text search. Apply whenever writing or renaming code: functions, types, constants,
files, error messages, doc comments.

Grounded in measurement: agents navigate by plain-text search, not by AST or
language server, so every identifier is a search query and every search miss
costs wasted reads.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让代码在纯文本搜索中既好找又好懂
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望代码库能被编码代理快速检索并理解。
copy.tagline_en: Write code that search agents can find and understand.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your codebase to be easily searchable by coding agents.

howto.what: Claude在写或改代码时，会遵守可搜索规则：给函数、类型等起含义明确的名字，在注释里写下搜索关键词，并让错误信息能直接搜到。
howto.when: 当你要求编写或重命名代码时触发，包括函数、类型、常量等，也适用于错误信息和文档注释。

say.text: 给这个函数起一个能通过搜索找到的名字，并写一行注释说明它的作用。
把错误消息改成以唯一前缀开头，便于在日志中定位。
say.note: 日志信息将可直连到代码位置。

say.text: 为这个用户ID参数使用品牌类型，避免传参时弄反。
say.note: 编译器能拦截参数顺序错误。

howto.what_en: When writing or renaming code, Claude follows discoverability rules: gives functions/types meaningful names, adds doc comments with searchable phrases, and keeps strings like error messages grep-able.
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever writing or renaming code, including functions, types, constants, files, etc. Also applies to comments and error messages.

say_en.text: Give this function a searchable name and add a one-line comment explaining its purpose.
Start the error message with a unique literal prefix for easy log lookup.
say_en.note: Log messages map directly to code.

say_en.text: Use a branded type for this user ID parameter to avoid swapping arguments.
